# Image-read fixtures

**Generated by `scripts/extract-image-fixtures.mts`. Do not hand-edit — re-run it.**

Stage C artifact of [`../../../docs/decomposition/image-read-base64-dump.md`](../../../docs/decomposition/image-read-base64-dump.md).

Every fixture is a **real record** from a real session, captured verbatim except that
each base64 payload is replaced by a 1×1 PNG and its original length recorded in
`$fixture.substitutions`. Structure, ordering, sibling fields, and declared MIME are
untouched. The rendering path never decodes these bytes — it branches on MIME, on
length, and on envelope shape — so the payload is the one part with no information
value and all of the privacy risk. See the header of the generator for the full
argument.
